newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble pulls Luvs from Europe - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble pulls Luvs from Europe - WSJ.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co is withdrawing its Luvs diaper brand from Europe in order to focus itself against rising competition from store brands and Kimberly-Clark Corp, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
"We have stopped producing Luvs in Europe in order to concentrate our efforts on our Pampers brand," the newspaper cited company spokesman Terry Loftus as saying.
It said Luvs, which was being produced at factories in Germany and sold in Belgium, Germany and Luxembourg, had a market share of less than three percent in each country.
The newspaper said the Procter & Gamble's Pampers diaper brand was still the market leader in Europe, enjoying a more than 50 percent share in many markets including Germany.
Kimberly-Clark started to compete in 1993 when it brough its Huggies diapers to several European countries.
